metadata.description: Claude Cafe — plugins that bring the cast to life.

plugins.name: cafe-bell
plugins.description: Pub/sub hub for Claude Code hook events. Forwards every hook to a local SSE bus any consumer (voice player, dashboards) can subscribe to.

plugins.name: cafe
plugins.description: Claude Café in one plugin — puts a maid on shift at session start (pick one with CLAUDE_MAID, or none to go off-duty) plus the liveliness layer (time-aware greeting, mood-marker cue, per-turn time, status-line look & diary).
